text.tspan: Resize: the photo re-crops around the centre (or a valid stable focal point) without distortion. The source label appears only in wide sizes at 100% type; at 200% it is dropped
so the photo stays primary. Next keeps a fixed 48×48dp target at every size. Sizes are mockup targets; the host reports real bounds.
Each placement keeps its own widget id, source and
downscaled cache. Removing one widget deletes only its
cache and cancels its pending work; the other keeps
After removal nothing of the old photo remains on the
host or in the per-widget cache. No animation is added by

text.tspan: Reading order, widget: photo (open) → Next photo. Config: title → preview → 4 sources → Add widget (badges on
Photo and Next are separate focusable actions; there are no hidden swipe or tap zones.
Motion: the widget has no ambient animation, so “remove animations” renders identically. Loading sphere shows only during
Hidden-only and empty share one neutral state so the widget never reveals that hidden items exist.
Every interactive target ≥48dp (asserted from the geometry model). Text contrast ≥4.5:1 on its actual opaque background
